name: Paramount Syntex
lm_rationale: Sobhagya Capital Options — 5 SME IPOs in 2026 (₹157.91 Cr), 1 of 5 listed positive (20%), -1.19% avg listing gain (chittorgarh 2026 SME tracker).
net_proceeds: ₹61.68 Cr (₹6,167.71 lakh) funds new spinning and dyeing machinery at the existing Ludhiana facilities, to be deployed in FY27; the remainder of the ₹81.79 Cr fresh issue, after issue expenses, goes to general corporate purposes. There is no OFS.
key_risks: The company has not yet placed orders for all the machinery the IPO funds, top ten customers were 54.81% of FY26 sales, and operations sit at a single location in Ludhiana, Punjab.
market_moat: Integrated plant covering fibre processing, tow dyeing, hank dyeing, spinning, bulking and packing, plus recycling of waste acrylic fibre imported mainly from Thailand and Shanghai into value-added yarn.
management: Promoters Punit Arora and Kumkum Arora; 91.74% pre-issue promoter holding drops to 59.63% post-issue.
prose_business: Ludhiana-based maker of acrylic, polyester, nylon, wool and blended yarns and dyed and recycled acrylic fibre, selling to apparel, hosiery, home-textile and knitting customers. FY26 revenue from operations was ₹122.03 Cr, with PAT of ₹13.87 Cr.
highlight_dev: The ₹61.68 Cr capex adds spinning and dyeing machinery at the existing Ludhiana sites (backed by a Garg & Associates DPR dated 16 Sep 2026), with the plant already running at 70% to 83% utilisation.
sector_outlook: The RHP's industry section expects India's total textile exports to reach US$ 65 billion by FY26, and FY24 textile exports including handicrafts stood at US$ 35.9 billion.
peer_sentence: At 16.84x post-issue P/E, Paramount sits below Shiva Texyarn (23.35x) and Sangam (India) (33.15x) but above Donear Industries (9.83x) in the RHP peer table, whose simple average is 22.11x; the RHP's separately stated industry P/E (average 45.08x, high 75.28x, low 14.88x) does not match that table.
verdict_reason: PAT doubled to ₹13.87 Cr, but the LM's 2026 listings average -1.19%
why: Paramount's FY26 total income rose 8.68% to ₹122.51 Cr while PAT more than doubled to ₹13.87 Cr, lifting RoNW to 32.50% with D/E at 0.78. At ₹127 it is 16.84x post-issue EPS and 3.56x FY26 NAV, inside the range of its RHP peer table. The whole issue is fresh capital, with ₹61.68 Cr going to machinery at the existing plant. The LM bench is the weak point: Sobhagya's five 2026 SME listings were 1 positive and averaged -1.19% on listing day. The FY26 profit jump follows two years of negative operating cash flow, and FY26 operating cash flow was only ₹5.90 Cr against ₹41.34 Cr of inventory.
suggestion: Watch subscription and GMP; fundamentals suit a long-term hold, but the LM's record makes listing gains unreliable.
